outline:
課程中主要的訓練可分為三個方向：一、人為環境管理；二、自然環境管理；三、環境系統分析。在此規劃方向的考慮下，將會邀請專家學者進行相關主題的演講。參與者透過密集討論、書面報告、或舉行口頭發表等方式，可以有效率地交換意見，獲得更深入而廣泛的認識。
Three categories are stressed in these basic training courses: the management of human environment, the management of natural environment, and the system analysis towards environment. Under the above goals, inviting addresses for special topics will be arranged though the courses. The Participants are encouraged to have intensive discussion, written reports, or further oral presentation. Efficient opinion exchange would be also expected to derive more extensive interest.
schedule:
第1週: 所務說明,
第2~8週: 專家學者演講,
第9週: 期中考週彈性調課
第10~17週: 研究方向報告,
第18週: 期末考週彈性調課
scorePolicy:
期中考週前繳交一篇600字以上手寫心得報告。
成績計算：30%平時表現（含出席）+40%期中心得+30%課堂心得＝學期總成績。
consultation:
每週三下午13:00~17:00, 或是透過事前的e-mail預約.
Every Wednesday afternoon, or by e-mail appointment.
aiUsage: ● 鼓勵學生使用生成式AI工具（Encourage students to use generative AI tools）

outline:
本課程將透過每週專題演講方式，讓學生了解環境工程與管理之最新理論,技術及最先進之研究成果。演講者之安排將以校外知名專家學者及校內各計畫執行者為主。
This course will provide important information regarding to the latest development or application on the environmental engineering and management. Invited Speakers are well-known scholars in areas related to environmental engineering and management. Graduate students or thesis advisors are also invited to report research results of their graduate studies.
